review_notes: Read the whole target file and checked for repeated reasoning inside it (e.g. the two sporadic branches in lBar_cases, the repeated `hc.le` branches, the theta/central-quotient prelude in card_center_quot_dvd and isTripleCover_lBar_of). Those are short or are branches inside a helper, so I did not report them. I grepped the repository for repeats of the target's longer blocks and found one cross-file duplicate: hXN in mem_thetaComponentsIn_closure repeats the proof of le_normalizer_iOf218 in Item2110Res3ProofAL.lean. I confirmed the import direction (AL imports Cent, Cent imports Data, so Data is upstream). I did not compile the proposed move. It looks safe because the lemma only needs `iOf218`, `layer`, `le_normalizer_map` and `LocalCores.layer_characteristic`, all of which the target already uses.

findings.problem: The step `hXN : X ≤ normalizer (I : Set G)` reproduces, almost line for line, the whole proof of `le_normalizer_iOf218` in Item2110Res3ProofAL.lean. Both blocks apply `le_normalizer_map` to the characteristic subgroup `layer ↥X`, prove `normalizer (layer ↥X) = ⊤` from `LocalCores.layer_characteristic` and `normalizer_eq_top_iff`, then rewrite with `range_eq_map` and `range_subtype`. The lemma is stated as `L ⊓ centralizer {d} ≤ normalizer (iOf218 L d)`, which is exactly hXN once `X` and `I` are unfolded. It sits downstream of the target file, so the target cannot use it and inlines a second copy.
findings.proposed_change: Move `le_normalizer_iOf218` (with its `omit [Finite G] in` header) from Item2110Res3ProofAL.lean into this file, before `mem_thetaComponentsIn_closure`. It stays in the same namespace `CFSG.RankThree.PartTwo.Sec21.Item2110Res3Proof`, and it needs no imports beyond those the target already has. Delete it from AL. AL imports Cent, Cent imports Data, so AL still sees it and `hPN : A ⊓ L ≤ normalizer (I : Set G) := hALX.trans (le_normalizer_iOf218 L d)` is unchanged. In the target, replace the whole `hXN` block with `have hXN : X ≤ normalizer (I : Set G) := le_normalizer_iOf218 L d`. The `set X`/`set I` abbreviations are definitional, so this should typecheck, though I have not compiled it.
findings.benefit: The characteristic-layer normalizer argument is stated and proved once instead of twice. The target loses about seven lines of low-level `rw ... at h1` plumbing, and a fix or change to `layer_characteristic` or `iOf218` only has to be made in one place.
